failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Coordinator query hop 2: 'Who composed the opera "I puritani" and what was their nationality?' - this query repeats information already answered in hop 1 which identified Bellini as the composer and as Italian. The coordinator reasoning for hop 3 acknowledges 'Both summaries have conclusively verified the claim... No additional evidence is needed' yet still proceeds with retrieval.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieves 10 documents about query systems and verification methodologies (Hitchens's razor, Facebook Query Language, Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements, Web search query, Dynaset, Microsoft Query, Reference Verification Methodology, Ranking, Query theory, Search suggest drop-down list) - all entirely irrelevant to the opera composer claim. These documents appear to have been triggered by the coordinator's query text 'No further query needed - claim verification is complete' being misinterpreted.
